name: Temperature Monitor
author: AlteringUX
description: Live package temperature on the bar with its own panel: current reading against warn/critical thresholds, a 10-minute trend sparkline with min/avg/max stats, and a per-sensor breakdown from `sensors`. Shares the ~/.local/bin/omarchy-sysmon sampler with cpumon and memmon.

barWidget.description: CPU temperature with per-sensor and trend breakdown
